title: The Singing Blade
text: A sword lies in the path, bright as the day it was forged, singing a battle hymn in a woman's voice. It wants a wielder, very insistently. The longer you stand there, the louder and angrier its song grows.

options.label: The strongest takes up the singing blade.

outcomes.text: It sings through every fight, and the fights go better.
It sings through every fight and every night, and it will not stop.

options.label: Bury it; no good comes of a sword that wants so badly.

outcomes.text: It sings under the earth for a long time. It is not a hymn any more.

options.label: The wisest asks it who it was before anyone touches it.

outcomes.text: She was a champion of an old House. She tells you how she died, and how to avoid it.
